bio: Fronted by an exquisite patio that is taken by storm in fine weather, this bistro occupies the site of the old village bakery, whose lovely stone wood-fired oven brings a promise of gourmet delights. The chef crafts dishes steeped in Mediterranean aromas in a concise menu that showcases market-fresh produce. Fine choice of wines by the glass: we are in Gigondas, after all!...
